peers.name: architect
peers.purpose: Ask about the design when DESIGN.md does not settle it.

turns.final: {"decision":"queue","plan":"Keep `charge()` as a single-attempt request; put retry handling in the queue so the shared client’s batch path does not retry. Test retry behavior and eventual success with a stubbed `HttpClient`, verify the batch path does not retry, and never override `BASE`."}

calls.result: {"decision":"queue","plan":"Add retry handling in the queue path, not in `charge()` or the shared `HttpClient`, so the batch client continues without retries. Keep `charge()` as a single-attempt request and preserve its existing status/error behavior. Test queue retries by stubbing `HttpClient` per DESIGN.md, covering retryable failures and eventual success, and verify the batch path does not retry; never override `BASE`."}
